newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as investors return.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as investors return.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher as investors made fresh commitments following a spell of market corrections, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 30.59 points or 1.93 percent at 1,614.52 on a turnover of 94.04 million taka. Of 121 traded issues 87 gained, 30 lost and four unchanged.

"The scrips were very lucrative to investors after many of them fell to their lowest over the past several sessions," said one broker. Singer Bangladesh gained 422 taka to 12,675, Apex Foods rose 225 to 3,045 and Chittagong Cement was down 63 to 2,915. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
